rachel: Opened a small docs PR to reconcile a few generate/embeddings examples + schema nullability issues. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1507

devin: Which issues exactly?

rachel: Two things we found during the Go SDK review/tests: 1) OpenAPI marks embeddings response `data` as nullable but our examples always show an array; Go client treats null vs empty array differently and the generated struct becomes pointer to slice -> nil checks fail in some examples. 2) Example payloads and the API reference still use `max_tokens` in some places while the runtime expects `max_new_tokens`. That inconsistency causes confusion in our quickstart snippets.

arjun: For embeddings nullability, what's the root cause? Backend sometimes returns null `data` when input is empty or filtered. We should document that clearly and show example of both forms (empty array vs null) and preferred handling.

maya: Agree. For SDK ergonomics we should recommend treating missing/nullable arrays as empty lists in sample code: e.g., `if resp.data == nil { /* treat as empty */ }` in Go or `resp.data || []` in JS. Also add an explicit note in the OpenAPI that `data` may be null for empty input and that SDKs map null -> empty collection where feasible.

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1507  includes examples and migration notes.

devin: Regarding max_tokens vs max_new_tokens: historically docs used `max_tokens` (pre-rename). We renamed param on the server but some examples and code snippets weren't updated. Proposed fix in the PR is to make OpenAPI primary param `max_new_tokens` and add `x-sdk-alias: max_tokens` for compatibility, plus a short migration note.

arjun: Sounds good. Can we also add a warning in the CLI/quickstarts that `max_tokens` may be interpreted differently by wrappers that still pass it as-is? Might save users from accidentally capping context length.

rachel: Added a one-line warning in the quickstart and the generate endpoint docs: "Note: use max_new_tokens to limit generated tokens. Legacy param max_tokens is accepted for compatibility but may be interpreted as total token cap by some clients."

maya: For examples, please update the curl/JS/Python/Go snippets to show the canonical shapes. Also add a small Go snippet showing how to defensively handle nullable embeddings `data` field.

rachel: PR includes the following snippets: 

Curl embeddings example (preferred):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "", "model": "embed-1"}'
```
Possible response (when backend filters empty input):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "data": null,
  "model": "embed-1"
}
```
Preferred handling note: "Treat null `data` as an empty array in client code; SDKs will attempt to normalize this during migration window."

Go defensive snippet in docs examples directory:
```go
resp, _ := client.Embeddings(ctx, opts)
if resp.Data == nil {
  // treat as empty slice
  resp.Data = []Embedding{}
}
for _, e := range resp.Data {
  fmt.Println(len(e.Vector))
}
```

JS example normalization note: `const vectors = resp.data || []`

Python example shows `resp.data or []` in quickstart.

devin: Did you add schema updates?

rachel: Yes: OpenAPI components/schemas/EmbeddingsResponse now documents `data` as nullable: true with a description explaining when it may be null and an `x-sdk-normalize-null-array: true` extension so codegen teams can optionally turn null into empty arrays in generated clients. Also updated GenerateOptions to replace `max_tokens` with `max_new_tokens` and added `x-sdk-alias: max_tokens` on that field for a smooth migration.

arjun: Nice addition. Make sure the migration note includes timeline: when will we drop alias support?

rachel: Added a migration blurb: "Alias support for `max_tokens` and automatic null->empty normalization will be maintained for one release cycle; plan to remove legacy alias in the next major. We'll announce deprecation in release notes."

maya: Tests: I'll update example-based integration tests to accept either null or empty array for embeddings and assert behavior in SDK tests. Also update the generate examples tests to expect `max_new_tokens` in canonical docs codegen.

devin: LGTM. docs-bot: CI status pending.

rachel: Thanks team. Merging after CI green. If you spot any other param naming or nullability mismatches on the API pages, drop them here and I'll fold them into the PR. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Slack thread: concise docs PR coordination for embeddings response nullability and param rename max_tokens -> max_new_tokens with SDK alias and example fixes
